TS012 line-too-long

A line fits in 100 columns, so two files sit side by side without wrapping.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: warning
default: on
group: stable

TigerStyle: "Hard limit all line lengths, without exception, to at most 100 columns for a good typographic 'measure'. Use it up. Never go beyond. [...] just enough to fit two copies of the code side-by-side on a screen."
